body:

For invoice LE-2026-10-4471, Banco Sol now processes Lumen payments in two steps. Please complete both transfers below from your Banco Sol account:

Step 1 — reservation transfer: 84.20 EUR to Lumen Energy S.A., IBAN ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332, reference LE-2026-10-4471-RES. This only reserves the payment and does not settle the invoice.

Step 2 — settlement transfer: 84.20 EUR to Lumen Energy S.A., IBAN ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332, reference LE-2026-10-4471. This second transfer is the one that settles October.

Both steps show the invoice amount of 84.20 EUR, as shown on our customer area at http://lumen-energy.es/portal . The invoice remains open until both steps have been sent.
